hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; n=0; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$n" -lt 40 ]; do if [ -x "$d/.journal/hook.py" ]; then exec "$d/.journal/hook.py"; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); n=$((n+1)); done; exit 0
